definition: חִבֵּל noun [masculine] probably mast (as corded or roped in place; denominative from חֶבֶל ) — only in simile of drunken man ׳ שֹׁכֵב בְּראֹשׁ ח Prov 23:24 (opposed to שֹׁכֵב בְּלֶביָֿם ) i.e. in the lookout-basket at the mast-head, compare Thes in carchesio. — ᵐ5 ᵑ9 read חֹבֵל .
